latestTerminalSummary:
The critic stage is complete. The single native Goal was activated and completed; its actual responses are preserved in [goal-lifecycle.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R1-01/treatment/stages/critic/goal-lifecycle.json). The completion response reports 184,038 tokens and 890 seconds.

Required outputs were saved before Goal completion:

- [critique.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R1-01/treatment/stages/critic/critique.md)
- [source-map.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R1-01/treatment/stages/critic/source-map.json)
- [sources/index.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R1-01/treatment/stages/critic/sources/index.md)

The review found one material caveat: a missing vibration signal cannot rule out structural coupling without suitable sensors and placement, consistent with the [FHWA guidance](https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/Environment/noise/measurement/handbook.cfm). It also recommends clarifying that the [Emslie case’s outdoor readings](https://www.acoustics.asn.au/conference_proceedings/AAS2008/papers/p64.pdf) were not a matched before-and-after comparison.

I used the immutable objective exactly as supplied. Its embedded path differs from the requested assignment and input-map path; I executed the requested stage path and created no replacement Goal.
